svg.title: UF SDE reproducibility verification system plan
svg.desc: One-page visual plan for building a public, DOI-archived reproducibility verification system for SDE biological models, showing the four layers, six agents, and four build phases.

g.text: Open contribution, expert judgment, public archive, no step hidden
